2026-09-21.patch_summary: This patch adds an empty bpf_memcg_ops type to allow attaching memory policies to cgroups, which is the first step in making memcg enforcement programmable one hook at a time. The patch also moves cgroup BPF attach types outside of CONFIG_CGROUP_BPF and fixes struct_ops registration stubs for all supported configurations. This does not change any existing behavior yet.
